name: @orbb/notifications
description: Deterministic notification/reminder engine for ORBB (M6-B B8, Lane A): computes reminder schedules from measurement-task snapshots (upcoming-due, missed-window, gentle REMIND -> REMIND_WITH_FALLBACK_OFFER escalation over the task's recorded fallback vocabulary), preference-gated quiet hours with defer-not-drop semantics, per-UTC-day idempotent reminder identities over an injectable dispatch ledger, and a fail-closed NotificationChannel abstraction with in-memory + seam-only SYNTH web-push/email provider doubles. Interface-driven: injected clock/ledger/channel registry; ZERO db imports, ZERO external runtime dependencies.
